description: This file defines the Upload model class for the Opencart admin tools, providing methods for managing uploaded files including adding, deleting, retrieving uploads and counting total uploads. It interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations related to file uploads.

classes.name: Upload
classes.description: Model class for handling file upload data within the Opencart admin area, extending the core engine model.

methods.name: addUpload
methods.description: Creates a new upload record in the database with the provided name and filename, generating a unique code token.

methods.name: deleteUpload
methods.description: Deletes an upload record from the database based on the upload ID.

methods.name: getUpload
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific upload by its ID.

methods.name: getUploadByCode
methods.description: Fetches an upload record based on its unique code.

methods.name: getUploads
methods.description: Returns a list of multiple uploads with filtering, sorting, and pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalUploads
methods.description: Returns the total count of uploads matching optional filter criteria.
